messages:
june-cs: FYI NovaFrontier has a combined NA+EU demo next week 09:30 UTC. They want a short cross-region surge and a header allowlist for their CDN signer. Renewal touchpoint in ~8 days; product thinks this is high impact if the demo has auth or latency failures.

matt-ops: Can you confirm spike multiplier, window (start/end), exact header format, and preferred regions? IPs/CIDR? Any fallback model requested?

june-cs: Product asks for +3x baseline QPS for 3 hours (2026-11-10T09:30Z -> 2026-11-10T12:30Z). Header-only allowlist: header X-NF-Sign with tokens like nf~live~[hex12]. No CIDR for now. Prefer routing to us-east-1 for NA and eu-west-1 for EU, with fallback to us-west-2 if needed. They also requested automatic fallback to a smaller quantized model (nf-lite-q4) if p95 latency > 360ms sustained for 90s. Auto-revoke after window. Please mark renewal_flag=high.

hira-eng: We can add header regex ^nf~live~[a-f0-9]{12}$. For routing we'll add region affinity by geo header and a fallback order [eu-west-1, us-east-1] -> us-west-2. Recommend alerts: p95>300ms OR 5xx_rate>1%. Will enable trace capture for any fallback hits.

matt-ops: Drafting CR now. Will include auto-revoke at 2026-11-10T12:30:00Z, header pattern, regional affinity, rate_multiplier=3, fallback_model=nf-lite-q4 with p95 condition, and alerts.

matt-ops: ```json
{\n  "customer":"novafrontier",\n  "change_request":"CR-2026-1110-nf-crossregion-demo",\n  "window_start":"2026-11-10T09:30:00Z",\n  "duration":"3h",\n  "rate_multiplier":3,\n  "region_policy":"preferred:[us-east-1,eu-west-1],fallback:[us-west-2]",\n  "header_whitelist":"X-NF-Sign:^nf~live~[a-f0-9]{12}$",\n  "fallback_model":"nf-lite-q4",\n  "fallback_condition":"p95_latency>360ms_for_90s",\n  "alerts":"p95>300ms OR 5xx>1%",\n  "auto_revoke":true\n}
```

hira-eng: LGTM. I'll stage the routing and flag nf-lite-q4 in the model catalog. Matt please attach the change request to the runbook and include rollback steps.

matt-ops: Change request CR-2026-1110-nf-crossregion-demo created and pushed to infra. Attaching runbook and scheduling auto-revoke.

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-1110-nf-crossregion-demo applied: rate_multiplier=3 (region affinity us-east-1 & eu-west-1 preferred, fallback us-west-2), header allowlist added for X-NF-Sign, fallback model nf-lite-q4 enabled with p95>360ms for 90s, alerts configured, auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-11-10T12:30:00Z.

elena-am: Noted  I'll tag account renewal_flag=high and schedule a post-demo outreach. June please collect a short customer diary, any 401/403 counts, and sample trace IDs for fallback hits; post a summary here within 24h after the demo.

june-cs: Will collect logs, auth failure counts, and traces. Will post concise summary within 24h. :memo:
